# improve git untag

Make `git untag` ([#34](DOT-34.md)) tolerate remotes that do not have the tag: "if remote doesn't have the tag, just remove it from local scope" — i.e. do not fail (or spam errors) pushing a deletion of a ref that is absent on `mirror` or `origin`; delete locally, and delete remotely only where the tag exists.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/168#issuecomment-5711683710
Code vs intent: the remote-tag check uses a per-repository, per-day-of-year cache under `/tmp/git/tags/…`; a tag pushed after the day's `ls-remote` was cached is treated as absent and never deleted remotely. Also `/tmp` + `%j` (day of year) collides across years, though `/tmp` is usually cleared before that.
-->
